source.quakec: https://github.com/nzp-team/quakec (clip timings/frame ranges derived from it)

conventions.morph_targets: target index == original MDL frame index; play clips with THREE.AnimationMixer
conventions.quantization: KHR_mesh_quantization: each model node <name> has a child <name>_q whose scale/translation dequantize int16 positions. Never overwrite the _q transform; transform the parent node.
conventions.clip_length_note: glTF clip length ends at the last key; manifest duration_s also includes the last frame hold. For looping clips use duration_s as the loop period (or LoopRepeat with clampWhenFinished=false).

models/props.glb.notes: All nodes sit at the origin; clone by node name and place using web/pack/ndu_entities_compact.json.

maps/ndu.glb.notes: Brush geometry; node grp_world, grp_brush_entities (func_wall/func_door_nzp/func_illusionary named <classname>_<entityIndex>_<targetname>), grp_sky (unlit), grp_collision (collision_clip: invisible player-clip brushes). No lightmaps (map source only) - add your own lights.

maps/ndu_entities.json.notes: All 432 entities with raw Quake keys + position_m, quaternion_xyzw, yaw_deg_about_Y, bbox_m for brush entities, node name for brush geometry, model_glb for model refs.
